laws.rule: Drivers may not read or write text messages or emails while the vehicle is moving (G.S. 20-137.4A). Drivers under 18 may not use a phone at all while driving, except in an emergency or to talk to a parent or spouse. A bill for a wider hands-free law (Senate Bill 797, the Hands Free NC Act) was before the General Assembly in 2025 and 2026; it had not been confirmed as law when checked.
laws.penalty_signal: US$100 plus court costs (about A$142 at RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040); no licence points.

laws.rule: Drivers must move over a lane, or slow down considerably, when passing stopped emergency vehicles, including NCDOT vehicles, with flashing lights. Injury or damage can bring misdemeanour or felony charges.
laws.penalty_signal: US$250 fine (about A$355 at RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040).

items.text: Cannabis is not legal for adult or medical use under North Carolina law. Possessing half an ounce (about 14 g) of marijuana or less is a Class 3 misdemeanour, and any jail sentence must be suspended; more than half an ounce is a Class 1 misdemeanour, and more than 1.5 ounces (about 42 g) is a felony (G.S. 90-95(d)(4)). Lower thresholds apply to hashish and extracts.

Spirits are sold only in ABC stores run by local ABC boards, or by the drink in licensed bars and restaurants (G.S. 18B-800). ABC stores may not open between 9 pm and 9 am, and are closed on Sundays, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day (G.S. 18B-802). Bills to let counties allow Sunday ABC store sales were drafted in 2023 and 2025; check the current statute.

layers.authority: US National Park Service, Great Smoky Mountains National Park
layers.process: The park lies in both Tennessee and North Carolina. A parking tag is required for any vehicle parked longer than 15 minutes. Daily US$5, weekly US$15, annual US$40 (about A$7, A$21, A$57). The tag must be physical, show the vehicle's plate, and isn't specific to a location; a tag does not guarantee a space; America the Beautiful passes don't replace it. Daily and weekly tags are sold on recreation.gov (up to six months ahead; print it), at visitor centres, retailers and 24-hour machines. Disability placards or plates, approved school groups and permitted researchers are exempt, and there are listed free days in 2026 (16 Feb, 25 May, 14 Jun, 3 to 5 Jul, 25 Aug, 17 Sep, 27 Oct, 11 Nov). Fees in US dollars; A$1 = USD 0.7040 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026), so US$1 is about A$1.42.
